RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.title: Ascensions
RELOCK_ASCENSIONS.SCREEN.intro:
Each Ascension starts at the highest level your runs on [gold]{profile}[/gold] have earned. Use the arrows to pick a different level, up to what you have unlocked.

Reset puts every row back to what your runs earned. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
